paper_metadata.title: Time-resolved synchrotron diffractometry of phase transformations in high strength nickel-based superalloys

evidence.quote: Phase transformations in prototype high strength polycrystalline nickel-based superalloys of varying Ti/Nb ratio are studied using time-resolved, high resolution X-ray synchrotron diffractometry.
The three different alloys contained varying concentrations of Ti and Nb with Nb being substituted for Ti on a 1:1 basis. The measured composition of each alloy is listed in Table 1.
